summary.zh: 选定目标国家并规划进入与本地化
summary.en: Choose a new market and plan entry, localization and compliance

description.zh: 进入新国家时的整体规划，覆盖国家选择、进入方式、本地化、监管要求和区域销售打法。适合评估第一个海外目的地，或本土增长见顶后寻找新战场。
description.en: End-to-end planning for entering a new country: picking the market, choosing the entry mode, localization, regulation and regional go-to-market. Fits a first overseas market or a home market that has stopped growing.
